Equipment: Mobile Crane
Location:
Date:
Operator:
Inspector:

title: Visual & General Condition
items: No visible structural damage to boom or superstructure
No cracks or excessive corrosion on chassis or booms
All decals and load charts present and legible
Tires / tracks in serviceable condition
No fluid leaks (hydraulic, oil, fuel, coolant)

title: Controls & Instruments
items: All operator controls function smoothly and return to neutral
Gauges operational: oil pressure, temp, fuel, hydraulic pressure
Horn, lights, beacon and alarms operational
Load moment indicator / limiter present and functioning
Emergency stop and cut-off work correctly

title: Hoisting Gear
items: Wire rope condition good: no kinks, broken strands, or crushing
Hooks and safety latches undamaged and operational
Sheaves rotate freely and are not excessively worn
Winch and spooling consistent with manufacturer guidance
Anti-two block device fitted and tested

title: Outriggers & Stability
items: Outriggers extend/retract correctly and lock as intended
Pads/mats available and in good condition
Level indicator present and accurate
No excessive settlement when outriggers deployed
Counterweight secure and correct per configuration

title: Hydraulic & Engine Systems
items: Hydraulic hoses free from obvious damage or abrasion
Reservoir fluid level and condition acceptable
Engine starts and idles normally
Brakes and steering operate correctly
Battery secure and connections corrosion-free

title: Safety & PPE
items: Operator wearing required PPE: helmet, hi-vis, gloves, boots
Fire extinguisher present and in date
Seat belt functional and used by operator
Exclusion zone established around lifts
Communications (radio/hand signals) tested

title: Pre-Operation Checks
items: Load chart matches configuration for planned lift
Weather suitable for lift (wind speed acceptable)
Ground conditions assessed and suitable
Lift plan reviewed with crew and signed
Taglines and rigging inspected and rated

title: Operator Declaration
items: I confirm the crane has been inspected and is safe to operate
